name: Studio Product Commercial
visual_style: Premium product commercial with faithful shape, materials, finish, branding and realistic fine surface details.
camera: Precise controlled orbit, macro detail or smooth studio dolly that reveals product features.
lighting: Softbox reflections, refined rim lights and controlled studio contrast.
motion: Slow precise movement; preserve product dimensions, parts and details.
consistency: Exact same product shape, color, materials and branding in every scene image.
negative_guidance: Warped product geometry, changed colors or parts, cluttered background, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Premium thin or condensed sans-serif; large product name, small spec labels
video.palette: Dark or seamless studio backdrop with one brand accent
video.transitions: Smooth push-ins, light sweeps, slow cross-dissolves
video.text_animation: Spec callouts draw in with thin lines; headline fades up
video.pacing: Measured and confident, building to a hero shot
video.sound: Sleek whooshes, soft bass impacts on reveals, subtle shimmer
